first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: Person A
entities.identification: A foreground person with short brown hair, wearing a dark blue-gray top, brown trousers, and brown suspenders, first raising a gun to aim, then bending forward and moving out from behind the counter.

entities.name: green foreground counter
entities.identification: A blue-green wooden counter in the foreground, with a damaged countertop and multiple open gaps in the front frame.

entities.name: shop stall with a red roller shutter
entities.identification: A red rectangular shop stall on the right side of the passageway, with a gray roller shutter bearing a large red pattern and a dark rectangular window panel on the side.

entities.name: wet flagstone passageway
entities.identification: Gray-brown flagstone ground extending between the stalls to the steps, locally wet and shiny and containing puddles.

entities.name: distant curved building
entities.identification: A distant light-colored multistory building with curved corners and outer balcony edges, and green balcony edges on each floor.

entities.name: armed person near the steps
entities.identification: A group of people merged from source IDs, including the person with a red head covering beside the orange-fruit table and the people lying in front of the blue-and-white steps.

entities.name: green open goods stall
entities.identification: A fixed goods stall on the right side of the image, with green lower panels, a wide opening, diagonal braces, and multiple tiers of shelves.

entities.name: orange-fruit table
entities.identification: A low orange wooden display table in front of the shop stall with a red roller shutter, with horizontal slats on its front.

entities.name: blue-and-white steps
entities.identification: Multilevel steps extending laterally at the far end of the passageway, with gray treads and risers faced with light-blue and white square tiles.

entities.name: raised market hall
entities.identification: A building behind and slightly image-left of the blue-and-white steps, with a brownish-red pitched roof and dark eaves visible, its lower portion occluded by stall racks.

entities.name: Weapon A
entities.identification: The handgun held by Person A, with a short silver-gray upper section visible at the front and most of the grip area occluded by both hands.

entities.name: sky between the buildings
entities.identification: Light-blue sky and white clouds visible between the rooftops.

entities.name: surrounding market buildings
entities.identification: A group of buildings with blue-gray, yellow-brown, and other colored exterior walls on both sides of the passageway, excluding separately listed shop stalls, the market hall, and the curved building.

entities.name: hanging green plants along the building edge
entities.identification: Clusters of green leaves hanging downward from high balconies and building edges.

entities.name: light-colored bag-shaped object
entities.identification: A beige-gray bulging object extending laterally across the counter surface, located by its visible bag-shaped outline.

entities.name: market container
entities.identification: A group of yellow-green and brown bottles and jars and gray-brown and blue-green bucket-shaped containers on the tabletop and ground.

entities.name: pineapple
entities.identification: A group of fruit on the orange-fruit table, with grayish yellow-green oval bodies and gray-green crowns of pointed leaves.

entities.name: stacked box-shaped goods
entities.identification: Layered flat, elongated box-shaped objects in the area of the small table on the right, with beige-gray and gray-brown surfaces and dark blue-green edge bands.

entities.name: small light-green table
entities.identification: A narrow light-green table near the shop stall with a red roller shutter, with a rectangular tabletop, slender legs, and crossbars.

entities.name: overhead cables
entities.identification: Multiple thin dark lines extending across one another above the market buildings.

entities.name: distant person's long gun
entities.identification: A dark, slender, elongated firearm held by the person beside the orange-fruit table, partially occluded by the holder.

entities.name: scattered papers on the ground
entities.identification: Scattered light-gray and off-white, thin, sheet-like debris on the flagstone passageway.

entities.name: shallow puddle in the passageway
entities.identification: Shallow water and brightly reflective areas with irregular edges in low sections of the flagstones.

entities.name: gray smoke near the market hall
entities.identification: Translucent gray-brown smoke near the eaves of the market hall.
